# Current Dc

Repository-owned M2E composition fixture. Reuses the independently authored current_source_load base golden. The analysis directive, placement and reviewed IR IDs were authored from current syntax/mapping contracts, without importing the production composer or directive builders. SHA-256 is transparent stdlib hashing of exact LF bytes. Tests never update these expectations.

Test callers explicitly review each approval level; no authority is stored in these files. No real LTspice/PyLTSpice, RAW parsing, metric or physical validation is claimed. MOS models/operating points and all actual simulator interoperability remain M2F work.
